fed.note: FOMC held the target range steady; dissenters Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack both wanted a 25bp hike. Chair Warsh called inflation "elevated" and said the Fed will cut the number of rate-setting meetings starting 2027. No new decision since (next meeting 9-10 Dec); minutes from the 27-28 Oct meeting are due 18 Nov at 2pm ET, after this run. No FOMC meeting fell in the last 7 days, so this block is carried forward unchanged. The 10Y eased slightly to 5.12% on 16 Nov from 5.15% on 13 Nov, after rising sharply earlier in November.

catalysts.name: NIQ Global Intelligence Plc
catalysts.what: NIQ beat Q3 2026 estimates (adjusted EPS $0.30 vs $0.23 consensus; revenue $1.12B, +6.3% y/y, vs ~$1.11B expected) and raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $1.16-$1.20 from $1.08-$1.12, its first GAAP-profitable quarter since its July 2025 IPO. The stock had already run up sharply (+54% since August) into the print, a risk flagged at the time; shares are now $18.33 (-2.4% today), down further amid the broad market selloff. No confirmed day-of closing-tape reaction is available to this routine (no OHLC access).

catalysts.name: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co.
catalysts.what: Barclays upgraded Reliance Steel & Aluminum (metals distributor) to Overweight from Equal Weight and raised its price target to $507 from $445 - about 17.8% above the ~$430 price at the time. Shares are now $420.32 (-0.2% today), little changed, as the broad market selloff (S&P 500 -1.0% today) continues - not a reversal of the catalyst itself. Consensus elsewhere is more mixed (Hold rating, ~$415 average target), so this is one bullish desk, not a reconciled consensus upgrade.

catalysts.name: Ecolab Inc.
catalysts.what: Wells Fargo (analyst Jason Haas) upgraded Ecolab to Overweight from Equal Weight and raised its price target to $380 from $315 on 13 Nov, about 25% above the $302.84 price - citing AI data-center build-outs driving Ecolab's high-tech water/hygiene business and pricing surcharges persisting into FY2027. Street consensus is more measured (Moderate Buy, ~$332-333 average target per one report, vs earlier October targets of UBS $357 / JPM $310 / Citi $345 / BofA $355), so this is one bullish desk's target, not a reconciled consensus. Shares are down 1.8% today with the broader market.

NIQ.what: Consumer-insights firm that tracks retail sales and shopper behavior worldwide to help brands and retailers make strategic decisions.

RS.what: Metals distributor: buys, processes and resells steel, aluminum and other metals for manufacturers, construction and aerospace customers.

ECL.what: Specialty chemicals company providing water treatment, hygiene and infection-prevention solutions to industrial, food-service and life-sciences customers worldwide.
